newsitem.title: TURKEY: One dead, five injured in Kurd militia shootings.
newsitem.headline: One dead, five injured in Kurd militia shootings.

text.p: A policeman on guard at a state hospital in Diyarbakir province was killed by two men dressed as anti-guerrilla 'village guard' militiamen late on Friday, police said.
Police said the two men, who both escaped, were members of the outlawed Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK).
In a separate incident, two militiamen and three civilians were wounded in a gun-battle between rival groups of village guards at a cafe in the southeastern city of in Diyarbakir.
The battle began when one group of guards, arriving in the city from an outlying village, spotted the rival group and sprayed the cafe with automatic gunfire, police said.
The role of the 70,000 mainly Kurdish village guards enrolled to help fight the PKK has been questioned recently after media allegations that many of them are involved in common crime.
More than 21,000 people have been killed in the 12-year-old conflict between the security forces and the PKK who are fighting for autonomy or independence in the mainly Kurdish southeast.
